an: turns secretive: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, smiles slyly and softly winks, one hand slowly tucks a small folded letter into her wide sleeve, the other hand rests on the rim, soft grey mist wisps drift
keeps her secret in a slow loop: she pats the letter hidden in her sleeve, gives a soft wink with a sly closed-mouth smile, the grey mist wisps drift slowly
binh: feels at peace: she leans a little forward over the gold rim holding a small celadon teacup in both hands, closes her eyes with a soft serene smile, a thin wisp of tea steam rises
stays calm in a slow loop: she raises the small teacup a little, takes a tiny sip with eyes closed, lowers it with a serene smile, the thin tea steam curls softly
dau: feels a quiet ache in her heart: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, both hands press a small old jade pendant to her chest, her brows tilt up in sorrow, her eyes glisten and one single tear rolls down; mouth stays closed, no sobbing

aches quietly in a slow loop: she holds the jade pendant to her chest, closes her eyes for a moment and breathes in sadly, her lips stay pressed together, the one tear glistens on her cheek; mouth closed, no sobbing, no streams of tears
muu: hatches a plan: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, lifts one small black go stone between two fingers to her chin, glances sideways with a sly smirk, one brow raised, the other hand rests on the rim
keeps scheming in a slow loop: she taps the go stone gently against her chin, narrows her eyes sideways with a knowing smirk, both eyes looking the same way, the other hand stays on the rim
ghen: turns jealous: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, raises a round silk fan to half cover her mouth, glances sideways with a sly sarcastic sneer and one raised eyebrow, the other hand rests on the rim; the disc stays deep jade-teal

keeps needling in a slow loop: she flutters the round silk fan gently in front of her mouth, side-glances with a sarcastic sneer, both eyes looking the same way, lifts one eyebrow; the disc stays deep jade-teal
